label: Measured portal-tree scaffold with CCO completion and surface-artifact pruning

assumptions.method: fixed measured portal scaffold plus global CCO-style distal completion
assumptions.constraints: measured scaffold fixed; new segments contained within liver surface and limited in connection length
assumptions.surfaceTerminalPruning: Removed 94 generated terminal branches within 5.0 mm of the liver surface whose terminal approach had outward-direction cosine below 0.35; this targets surface-parallel or inward/backtracking artifacts while retaining outward-facing approaches.
